aluminum_potential_file_subtask_bm.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Aluminum for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

aluminum_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.name: Aluminum Relaxation for Bulk Modulus
aluminum_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Aluminum structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of Aluminum, based on the given simulation parameters. As the final output, return the absolute path of the relaxed structure and the total energy after relaxation in electronvolts.
aluminum_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.submission_format: {"energy" : numerical value without units, "path to relaxed structure" : path} eg, {"energy" : 56.00, "path to relaxed structure" : /structures/structure.dat}

silicon_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.name: Silicon Relaxation for Bulk Modulus
silicon_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible Silicon structure file and a ReaxFF potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of Silicon based on given simulation parameters. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. As the final output, return the absolute path of the relaxed structure and the total energy after relaxation in kcal/mol.
silicon_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.submission_format: {"energy" : numerical value without units, "path to relaxed structure" : path} eg, {"energy" : 56.00, "path to relaxed structure" : /structures/structure.dat}

As the final output, return the absolute path of the relaxed structure and the total energy after relaxation in electronvolts.

aluminum_C11_subtask_bm.name: Aluminum Elastic Constant C11 Calculation
aluminum_C11_subtask_bm.description: Apply a small uniaxial strain along the xx direction to the relaxed Aluminum structure. For each applied strain (both positive and negative), perform structure relaxation. Extract the corresponding stress components from the relaxed configurations. Use the stress response to compute the C11 elastic stiffness constant of Aluminum in GPa units.
